channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — Physics
channel.description: Free physics study notes and revision guide with worked examples covering classical mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, and more.

item.title: Newton's Laws of Motion
item.description: Three laws of motion, inertial frames, free body diagrams, friction, and applications to everyday mechanics problems.

item.title: Energy, Momentum, and Conservation Laws
item.description: Kinetic and potential energy, work-energy theorem, linear and angular momentum, and conservation principles with worked examples.

item.title: Rotational Dynamics
item.description: Moment of inertia, torque, angular momentum, rolling motion, and the parallel axis theorem with detailed derivations.

item.title: Thermodynamic Laws
item.description: Zeroth through third laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, entropy, and the Carnot cycle with quantitative problem solving.

item.title: Maxwell's Equations
item.description: Gauss's law, Faraday's law, Ampere-Maxwell law, and the displacement current. Integral and differential forms with applications.

item.title: Electric Fields and Potentials
item.description: Coulomb's law, electric field lines, electric potential energy, and voltage in continuous charge distributions with worked exercises.

item.title: Wave Optics and Interference
item.description: Young's double slit experiment, diffraction gratings, thin film interference, and the Michelson interferometer with derivations.

item.title: The Schrodinger Equation
item.description: Time-dependent and time-independent Schrodinger equation, wave functions, probability interpretation, and the particle in a box.

item.title: Quantum Harmonic Oscillator
item.description: Algebraic solution using ladder operators, energy eigenvalues, wave functions, and the correspondence principle with worked solutions.

item.title: Crystal Structure and Bragg Diffraction
item.description: Crystal lattices, Miller indices, Bragg's law, X-ray diffraction, and reciprocal lattice vectors with practical examples.

item.title: Band Theory of Solids
item.description: Energy bands, Fermi level, metals semiconductors and insulators, effective mass, and Bloch's theorem for electrons in crystals.

item.title: The Standard Model of Particle Physics
item.description: Quarks, leptons, gauge bosons, the Higgs mechanism, Feynman diagrams, and the four fundamental forces of nature.

item.title: Cosmology and the Expanding Universe
item.description: Friedmann equations, dark matter, dark energy, the cosmic microwave background, and the Big Bang model with observational evidence.

item.title: Physics — Complete Guide
item.description: Free physics study notes covering classical mechanics, thermal physics, electromagnetism, optics and waves, quantum mechanics, solid state physics, and particle physics and cosmology.
